stop_rule: Execute this fixed grid once. Preserve all outcomes. No additional scientific tests, adaptive grid points or receiver tuning.

test_1.name: continuous_source_noise_snr_sweep
test_1.noise: Independent Gaussian per sample/channel; identical standard-normal realization for matched prime/null and across sigma; random.Random.gauss rounded to 12 significant digits before native addition
test_1.source: Reuse authenticated continuous analytic source and passing independent dynamics from GW_COM_CONTINUOUS1
test_1.snr: Full-record per-channel modulation RMS / sigma and sqrt(sum of both noiseless modulation channels squared)/sigma; carrier RMS reported separately
test_1.fit: Existing exact joint two-channel fits with 2 and 4 coefficients; calibration [0,128), holdout [128,192); simplest adequate; holdout max <= 6*sigma+1e-10, declared for Gaussian noise
test_1.extractor: Unchanged continuous 3% carrier-amplitude residual norm threshold, group gap2, active group lengths3..17; four sync markers and seven data intervals; ratio tolerance3/25
test_1.admission: Matching lineage, quiet holdout, agreement across adequate fits, inherited passing source dynamics, matched unmodulated has no repeated frame; >=2 disjoint repeats and permutation p<=1/20 against99 full-search shuffled gaps
test_1.report: Every seed/case; exact payload evaluated only after gated decoding; empirical counts only, no population recovery probability

test_2.name: physical_scaling_detectability
test_2.detector: One ideal optimally aligned detector Fplus=1,Fcross=0; fixed Advanced LIGO design ASD T1800044-v5; not measured current sensitivity
test_2.spectrum: One-sided discrete rho^2=4*df*sum(|dt*FFT(h)|^2/ASD^2) over positive frequencies in supplied curve; exclude unsupported frequencies; log-log ASD interpolation; residual has zero endpoints and no taper; carrier Hann tapered with no loss correction
test_2.report: Carrier strain amplitude, modulation peak/RMS and optimal known-residual-template SNR versus R; rho=8 reference distance is illustrative and not a decoder threshold or detection claim; v/c, wave-zone ratio, duration, force/work scales, leading circular GW luminosity and inspiral time
test_2.scope: Newtonian leading-quadrupole scaling of held controlled source; no cosmological redshift, radiation-reaction evolution or realizable actuator design; radiation losses reported separately

test_3.name: expanded_natural_carrier_false_positives
test_3.slow_chirp: omega(t)=1+0.1*t/616; phase=t+0.05*t^2/616; leading adiabatic amplitude=8*omega^(2/3); hp=-amplitude*cos(2phase), hx=-amplitude*sin(2phase)
test_3.precession_like: inclination=0.6+0.2*sin(0.03*t), polarization_angle=0.3*sin(0.017*t); hp0=-4*(1+cos(inclination)^2)*cos(2t), hx0=-8*cos(inclination)*sin(2t); rotate pair by2*polarization_angle
test_3.scope: Unmodulated phenomenological natural-carrier nuisance waveforms; precession-like projection is not a spin-precession dynamics simulation
test_3.analysis: Unchanged stationary 2/4-coefficient carrier fits, clean holdout tolerance1e-10; evaluate full signed residual and repeated-frame search even if fit inadequate; report any repeated integer packet and permutation admission, independently of physical fit rejection
test_3.success_criterion: Neither nuisance generates a repeated packet satisfying existing repetition/permutation criteria. Model absorption is reported only if actually observed.

roles.native: noise addition, exact fits and signed residuals, nuisance projection combinations, source scaling algebra and spectral weighted sums, exact permutation ranks
roles.python: declared Gaussian/trigonometric/fractional-power constants, FFT and ASD interpolation, discrete symbol/permutation enumeration, independent serialization/arithmetic verification
